title: Deposit Pricing Determination on the Rate of a Certificate of Deposit Term
content:
The rate of a term of a certificate of the Certificates of Deposit line is fixed at the start of that term and does not move with the published rate sheet thereafter.

## 1. The rate and the yield in force

The rate of a term is the tier's standard interest rate plus bonus points, and the annual percentage yield is the tier's standard annual percentage yield plus the same bonus points. The two carry the same points; they never diverge in the points added.

## 2. Bonuses

The two bonuses stack by simple addition. No other bonus exists on this line.

Two clauses of this determination governing when each bonus is earned are **no longer in force**, having been superseded by the current basis on which those figures are settled. They are registered against this determination so that the bonuses they concern remain traceable, and they are not to be applied:

- the clause awarding the tier's relationship bonus points where the customer holds an active checking account of a tier the certificate's own tier lists as qualifying on the opening date or the renewal date — **no longer in force**;
- the clause awarding the tier's jumbo bonus points where the tier offers that bonus and the certificate's principal at term start reaches the tier's jumbo principal figure — **no longer in force**.

The figures themselves, the bonus points each tier publishes and the checking tiers each recognises, remain valid and are published on the relationship pricing schedule for this line.

## 3. Principal at term start

For a new certificate, the principal at term start is the opening deposit. The clause measuring that principal for a renewal, as the balance standing on the renewal date after any grace-period additions and withdrawals, is **no longer in force** and is superseded by the current basis.

## 4. Renewal

On renewal the rate follows the basis the tier publishes: the target tier's standard rates published on the maturity date, with both bonuses examined again on the renewal date where the tier re-examines the relationship bonus at renewal.

## 5. A bonus gained or lost mid-term

A bonus that is later lost, for example by closing the qualifying checking account, stays in the rate until the term ends. A bonus that becomes available part way through a term is not added until the next term. A 36-Month Certificate opened without the relationship bonus therefore pays 3.49 percent for the whole of its term even if the owner opens a Premier Checking account in its second month.

superseded_clauses: The relationship bonus of relationship_apy_bonus points applies when the customer holds an active checking account of a tier listed in relationship_qualifying_checking_tiers on the opening date or renewal date.
The jumbo bonus of jumbo_apy_bonus points applies when the tier's jumbo_eligible is true and the certificate's principal at term start is at least jumbo_threshold
for a renewal it is the principal_balance on the renewal date after any grace-period add-ons and withdrawals
